title: Add workspace-keyed wiki export data dump and import hydration
description: Add a wiki export flag that includes a JSON data dump of all MCP tables keyed to the source workspace.
Add an add-workspace parameter that locates such a data dump and imports it to hydrate a repository on a new MCP Server instance.
During import, remap workspace identity and machine-specific paths so the hydrated records are keyed appropriately for the new machine and active workspace.
Deprecate todo.yaml as a pass-through store of TODO items; TODO data should hydrate from the authoritative MCP data dump instead of workspace-local YAML shadow state.
Clean up existing todo.yaml files in a workspace during the migration path using an explicit, audited, non-destructive archive or removal workflow.
Preserve existing wiki export behavior unless the new flag is explicitly supplied.
technicalDetails: The export dump must include TODO table data and related requirement links from the authoritative MCP store, keyed by workspace identity in the dump and remapped on import.
todo.yaml must be treated as deprecated compatibility/shadow state, not an authoritative pass-through store for TODO items after the hydration feature lands.
add-workspace import hydration must not reintroduce todo.yaml as a source of truth; it should import TODO rows from the JSON dump and bind them to the new workspace key/path.
Workspace cleanup must discover existing todo.yaml files, classify whether each is generated/shadow/deprecated, preserve evidence through archive or report, and avoid silent data loss.
The migration must document what happens when both a dump and todo.yaml exist, including precedence, diagnostics, and operator-visible remediation.

implementationTasks.task: Define FR/TR/TEST requirements and acceptance criteria for workspace-keyed JSON export and import hydration.
Extend wiki export command/options to optionally emit a JSON dump covering all relevant MCP tables with source workspace metadata.
Design a portable dump schema with version, source workspace key, path metadata, table payloads, TODO rows, TODO requirement links, and integrity/diagnostic information.
Extend add-workspace with a parameter for locating a dump file or dump folder during workspace registration.
Implement import hydration that remaps workspace IDs, workspace paths, machine-specific keys, TODO records, and any workspace-scoped foreign keys for the new server.
Deprecate todo.yaml as a pass-through TODO item store and route TODO hydration through the authoritative JSON data dump instead.
Add workspace cleanup handling for existing todo.yaml files, including discovery, audit evidence, non-destructive archive/removal behavior, and diagnostics when cleanup is skipped.
Add validation for malformed dumps, version mismatch, missing tables, duplicate workspace mappings, unsafe external paths, todo.yaml/dump conflicts, and stale compatibility YAML.
Add focused unit and integration tests for export, import, remapping, TODO hydration, todo.yaml deprecation, cleanup/idempotency, and existing no-flag behavior.
Update docs, CLI/help text, wiki export guidance, add-workspace guidance, todo.yaml deprecation guidance, and generated requirement exports.
